description:
Returns current counts of tender notices: open, urgent (deadline within 14 days), awarded and total, plus the size of the semantic search index, the embedding model name and the health of the portal links. Intended for requests where the user asks how many tenders are currently open or how large and current the tender data is. No parameters. Key output fields: open_count, urgent_count, awarded_count, total_count, index_size.

Example user questions: "Wie viele Ausschreibungen sind aktuell offen?"; "Wie aktuell ist die Vergabe-Datenbank?"; "Gibt es dringende Ausschreibungen mit Frist in 14 Tagen?"
name: get_tender_counts
title: Anzahl der Ausschreibungen abrufen
